A workspace has no plan when its 14-day trial ended without a choice, or when its subscription ended. Nothing is deleted at once. The workspace goes through stages, and you get an e-mail before each one. Whoever has the right to manage billing can get out of it at any time by choosing a plan.

## The stages

| Stage | When | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| **Read-only** | From the day the plan ends, for 30 days | Everything is visible and people can sign in. Nothing new runs. |
| **Paused** | After 30 days | The workspace is stopped. Your data is kept. |
| **Trash** | After 90 days without a plan | The workspace is put in the trash. It can still be restored. |
| **Deleted** | 30 days later, so 120 days without a plan | The workspace and its data are deleted for good. The address becomes free. |

## Read-only

The Studio shows a banner: "No plan in force. Everything here is still yours to see; nothing new runs until a plan is chosen." The button **Choose a plan** is for the person who manages billing; the others are told to ask them. An execution you start is refused with the message "This workspace has no plan in force: choose one in Administration > Subscription. Everything in it is still here."

You can still read your agents, workflows and data, and export everything from **Administration** > **Data**.

## Paused

The workspace does not open. The page says **This workspace is paused** and offers to send the link again to the owner. That link reactivates the workspace. It opens again a minute after the payment of a plan. A link can be asked once every 10 minutes.

## The e-mails

The owner gets an e-mail:

1. when the plan ends;
2. 7 days before the pause;
3. when the workspace is paused;
4. 7 days before it goes to the trash;
5. when it goes to the trash;
6. 7 days before it is deleted.

Each e-mail has a button, **Choose a plan** or **Reactivate my workspace**.

## Come back

Choose a plan in **Administration** > **Subscription**, or use the link of the e-mail. Everything you built is still there: see [Subscription](/docs/administration/subscription/). A workspace in the trash can be restored, but one that was deleted cannot.
